subject: mathematics
title: Add-Up Adventure · Q2 W04 D05
objective: Add numbers with sums up to 10,000, with or without regrouping.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Add from ones to thousands. Regroup 10 ones as 1 ten, 10 tens as 1 hundred, and so on. Ready to explore?

vocabulary.definition: a number that is added to another number
to trade 10 ones for 1 ten (or 10 tens for 1 hundred)

activities.instruction: Listen to Milo. He will show you how to add from ones to thousands.
activities.content: Add from ones to thousands. seven hundred fifty two plus one hundred sixty eight equals nine hundred twenty. Regroup 10 ones as 1 ten when needed.

items.explanation: The answer is “920.” It applies the lesson skill about number skills.

items.prompt: Which number sentence is correct for seven hundred fifty two plus one hundred sixty eight?
items.explanation: The answer is “752 + 168 = 920.” It applies the lesson skill about number skills.

items.prompt: When you add seven hundred fifty two and one hundred sixty eight, which place do you add first?
items.explanation: The answer is “ones.” It applies the lesson skill about number skills.
